description: Up to eight ranked setups for one window (1m, 1h, 1d, 1w or 1y), each with its score, the scored inputs, why now, what would invalidate it, a risk posture and an as-of time. Deterministic: no LLM touches the score. An empty window says why. The ranking has no proven edge yet: see get_setups_track_record. Free.
name: best_setups
